The '''Book of Memories''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] written by the [[Tarasin]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was kept by the Tarasin deep within the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The book recorded all of the people that had acted to protect Cularin and the planet's secrets, to ensure that such people were remembered. In about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a member of the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;sacrificed themselves to prevent a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] known as the [[Darkstaff]] from destroying Cularin, and the agent's name was subsequently inscribed into the Book of Memories.
